value.name: Marylin arrives at Miles's door
value.description: Miles opens the door and finds Marylin standing outside, returning after being released on bail.
evidence: Miles opens the door. Marylin is standing there.
MILES Well. Well. Well. Look who made bail!

value.name: Marylin asks to enter
value.description: Marylin requests permission to come inside, signaling an intrusive confrontation rather than a friendly visit.

value.name: Miles mocks Marylin as criminal
value.description: Miles taunts Marylin with jokes about mace and his lack of experience with criminal minds, establishing hostility and his legal self-image.
evidence: MILES I don't know. Maybe I should grab my mace. I'm a civil attorney. I have little experience with "the criminal mind."

value.name: Marylin demands her belongings
value.description: Marylin says she has come to collect some of her things, asserting a claim to the house and its contents.
evidence: MARYLIN I'd just like to pick up a few of my things
MILES I don't believe you have "things."
MARYLIN On the contrary. We're married and we have no pre-nup, so a case could be made that everything in here is mine.

value.name: Marylin enters and sits on new sofa
value.description: Marylin walks into the den and sits on the new sofa, acting as if she has a right to be there.
evidence: Marylin walks into the den. Sits on the new sofa.

value.name: Marylin threatens Miles
value.description: When Miles asks what she wants, Marylin bluntly says she wants to ruin him.
evidence: MARYLIN I want to nail you ass.
